method: manual read + grep of src/fmsave/*.py; no import, no execution
grade_policy: all entries are external reference (ext), never our L1-L4 grades

grammar.statement: Save file begins with the 6-byte magic 02 01 66 6d 66 2e ("\x02\x01fmf."); anything else is NotAFmSaveError.
Fixed 26-byte header; the byte run of zstd frames starts at 26.
u64 at header offset 9 is the trailer offset relative to byte 9: trailer_offset = 9 + read_u64(header, 9).
The trailer region starts with a 9-byte header that repeats the file magic; the rest of the region is ONE zstd frame whose payload is the save directory.
Directory frame offsets are relative to byte 26: entry.frame_offset = 26 + relative_offset.
Directory entries with extension .dat or .cmt are sections; .apm/.scm are per-match files that are not sections and carry the injury-type name table.
Directory payload: u32 length + UTF-8 save name (max 4096), then a u32 of unidentified meaning that is skipped.

evidence.text: cursor += 4  # a u32 whose meaning is not identified

grammar.statement: Each entry: u32 name length (1..256) + ASCII name [A-Za-z0-9_]+, u32 extension length == 4, 4-byte extension ".xxx", then <5Q = relative frame offset, compressed size, decompressed size, two unidentified trailing u64; fixed tail is 40 bytes.
The entry list ends where the name-length prefix stops being 1..256 (i.e. a zero or out-of-range u32). Entries are then sorted by frame offset.

evidence.text: return save_name, tuple(sorted(entries, key=lambda entry: entry.frame_offset))

grammar.statement: Regions are the section frames plus the gaps between them, named unlisted_after_<previous entry>; the gap after non_pl_hist_ls holds the fixture calendar, league tables and rules preambles.

Every section is exactly one zstd frame (magic 0xFD2FB528); skippable frames 0x184D2A50..0x184D2A5F are recognised while walking; block header is 3 bytes little-endian: bit0 last, bits1-2 type (1=RLE, 3=reserved), size = header>>3, max block 128 KiB.

One frame is decompressed whole with a hard output cap (max_length = cap+1); afterwards the decoder must be at eof, must have no unused_data, and output length must equal the directory's decompressed_size.
Anti-bomb bounds: one part may expand at most 64x, a whole save at most 32x, with a 64 MiB floor allowance; measured real saves peak at 41x per part and 5x per save.

A decompressed section starts with 4-byte signature 03 01 + the extension bytes REVERSED ("dat" -> "tad", hence the t-a-d prefix our container layer already knows), then a u16 schema number at offset 6.

Per-section schema numbers observed for FM26 26.3.2: game_db=4000, save_game_summary=29, game_info=46, humans=21, feeder_man=5, injury_manager=8, job_centre=1, tactics_man=26, training_man=31, match_stats_cfg=6; match_file and the unlisted span carry schema None.

Layout lookup key is (region, schema, build) with fallback ladder: own build+schema -> schema on a build whose layouts fit every region -> own build -> FALLBACK_BUILD 26.3.2+2329565. A build is either in KNOWN_BUILDS (its layouts fit every region) or it borrows.

evidence.text: class LayoutEntry: region, schema, build, layout

grammar.statement: FM27 builds only borrow from other FM27 builds; tiers are own build+schema, lent schema, own build, lent. A cross-schema hit emits UnknownBuildWarning; two layouts fitting the same tier raise UnsupportedGameError.

evidence.text: if any(entry.layout != first.layout for entry in tier): raise UnsupportedGameError

grammar.statement: Variable-length rows are walked by a RecordStep list: each step optionally reads a count of 1/2/4 bytes, then consumes count*(lead_bytes+tail_bytes) plus strings*(4+len). The nation table: row_count=251, opening byte 0, 14 steps.

evidence.text: def _steps(data: bytes, position: int, steps: tuple[RecordStep, ...], maximum: int)

grammar.statement: A counted table opens with <IB = u32 row count + one zero byte, then the first record's opening byte; records follow at +5.
Records close with a 3x u32 footer <III = (row position, database id, third word); the club table uses the same <III footer with uid = word[1].

Club table: 5-byte header (u32 count + zero byte), rows whose byte 0 is variant 0 (ordinary) or 12 (extended, +4 prefix), prefix 26 bytes, then two u32-prefixed name strings, then RecordStep sequences (after_names, finance chain with tags 0/1/2, after_finance).

evidence.text: if header < 0 or header + layout.header_bytes > len(data)

grammar.statement: Fixed club record header offsets (from record start): index 0, uid 4, uid copy 8, zero byte 12, nation 13, FA nation 21, nation copy 25, city 29, long name 39; anchor ff ff ff ff at +17.

Player records are located by marker 01 00 6c 07 at +102 from record start; the identity header words sit BEFORE the marker (pindex -19, uid -15, uid copy -11, object kind -7, reps -6/-4/-2); CA at 0, PA at +2, team id +16, 15 position ratings at +24, 54 attribute bytes at +39.

A contract chain is a hit of tag 01 00 6c 07 in a window around the player record whose u32 at +5 equals pindex+1; wage at +17 from the tag, team id +9; a tail block is located by stepping back 66 + 29*event_count bytes and checking sentinel byte 3 and sentinel word 4.

evidence.text: The tail is found by trying E = M - tail_base_offset - tail_step_bytes * event_count

grammar.statement: Tagged property streams store 4-byte tags BYTE-REVERSED (bytes "csed" read as tag "desc"), separated by 0x01; value type codes: u8=0x11, u16=0x12, u32 in {0x01,0x02,0x03,0x0B,0x0F}, string=0x1A, list=0x0A, nil=0x00.

evidence.text: The tag is stored byte-reversed, so the bytes `csed` are the tag `desc`.

grammar.statement: All strings are u32 byte length + that many UTF-8 bytes (no terminator).
A game date is 4 bytes: u16 packed (day-of-year = packed & 0x1FF, intra-day slot = packed >> 9) followed by u16 year (1901..2200). Null/listing date sentinel is 0x076C0001 = 1 Jan 1900.

Person block (inside game_db): window starts 100 bytes before, personality 8 bytes at birth+21, nation id at birth+13, name ids at block+0/5/10, legal name length at +15 and text at +19, relations at birth+39 with 16-byte entries and 0xFF sentinel.

Staff records: kind byte at +12 (1 = staff, 9 = human), uid +4, uid copy +8, entry count +13 with 7-byte entries, ability base +21 (CA +0, PA +2), 26 preference bytes from +14 (14 slots named), then a 26-byte rated block from +40.

Every reader returns a Table plus GateResult checks against a GateBounds record (counts, medians, shares); strict mode raises ReaderCheckError, non-strict warns once per reader. Bounds describe measurements, not severity.

wire_vs_memory_note: fmsave describes the SAVE FILE wire format (zstd frames + in-memory serialisation of the game database). It never describes live process memory; see fm24_memory_layout.json for that separate domain.
not_in_scope: No FM24 support: SUPPORTED_GAME_MAJOR = 26 (src/fmsave/_version.py:53); FM24 saves are rejected.
No decryption layer of any kind: sections are plain zstd frames.
The directory entry's two trailing u64 and the post-name u32 are explicitly unidentified.
